mintAuthority.summary: PUSD has one authored Polygon-native UUPS-proxy ERC-20 deployment. The reviewed wrapper contracts deposit USDC or USDC.e before minting; three upgradeable market modules hold its separate minter role and mint against position-claim settlement in their current implementations. A 3-of-7 Safe controls the 12-hour Timelock. The newly identified PermissionedRamp holds wrapper role 2 and requires witness signatures. The token and all three module implementations have changed since the July observation. External transfer rails remain separately reviewed under Bridge Risk; PUSD does not create base USDC supply.

controls.label: Polymarket CollateralOnramp (immutable, wrap-only mint path)
controls.capDescription: CollateralToken.wrap() accepts only USDC or USDC.e, mints the requested amount, and transfers the same amount of pre-deposited collateral to the immutable vault within the same atomic transaction.
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 94755001, token rolesOf(onramp) returned 2 and owner() returned Timelock 0x47ebfac3353314c788b96cdcbf41daadfe03629c. Correct EIP-1967 implementation and admin slots were zero. The verified immutable onramp transfers collateral from the caller to PUSD before calling wrap(); the current token implementation atomically mints and forwards that amount to VAULT. The onramp's per-asset pause surface remains present; USDC.e was unpaused.

controls.label: Polymarket CollateralOfframp
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 94755001, token rolesOf(offramp) returned 2 and owner() returned the Timelock. Correct EIP-1967 implementation and admin slots were zero. Verified immutable source exposes unwrap(), not mint() or wrap(); it transfers caller-approved PUSD into the token before burning and paying collateral. Its USDC.e pause gate was unpaused at the pinned block.

controls.label: Polymarket legacy CTF collateral adapter
controls.capDescription: Wraps only USDC.e returned by merging or redeeming legacy conditional-token positions and transfers the same amount into PUSD before minting.
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 94755001, token rolesOf(adapter) returned 2, owner() returned the Timelock, and correct EIP-1967 implementation and admin slots were zero. Verified source transfers realized legacy USDC.e into PUSD and calls wrap() for that amount.

controls.label: Polymarket legacy NegRisk collateral adapter
controls.capDescription: Wraps only USDC.e returned by legacy neg-risk position conversion and transfers the same amount into PUSD before minting.
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 94755001, token rolesOf(adapter) returned 2, owner() returned the Timelock, and correct EIP-1967 implementation and admin slots were zero. Verified source transfers realized legacy USDC.e into PUSD and calls wrap() for that amount.

controls.label: Polymarket BinaryModule
controls.capDescription: Current implementation mints only when merging a complete YES/NO pair or redeeming a resolved position, with the corresponding position claims burned.
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 94755001, rolesOf(module) returned 1, owner() returned the Timelock, and the current implementation was 0xf6428c0b5fa9361c0708cddb95468cf54c56e9a2. Verified BaseModule source mints PUSD and burns corresponding position claims in the same transaction. Its separately permissioned mintFromBridge() creates position claims; the bridge-role census and conservation boundary require separate review.

controls.label: Polymarket NegRiskModule
controls.capDescription: Current implementation mints only when merging a complete neg-risk position set or redeeming resolved positions, with the corresponding claims burned.
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 94755001, rolesOf(module) returned 1, owner() returned the Timelock, and the current implementation was 0x39a5b01a100edf811f2748aa37b1313715ded70e. Verified source burns corresponding position claims when it mints PUSD. Its separately permissioned mintFromBridge() creates position claims; the bridge-role census and conservation boundary require separate review.

controls.label: Polymarket CombinatorialModule
controls.capDescription: Current implementation mints only when compressing, merging, or redeeming position claims, with the corresponding position claims burned.
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 94755001, rolesOf(module) returned 1, owner() returned the Timelock, and the current implementation was 0xf96968a44022b17240b42c557693e7c383d2d8a3. Verified source burns corresponding position claims when it mints PUSD in merge, compress, and redemption paths.

controls.label: Polymarket governance Safe through 12-hour Timelock
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 94755001, the token owner remained Timelock 0x47ebfac3353314c788b96cdcbf41daadfe03629c; minDelay() returned 43200, and admin, proposer, executor, and canceller roleHolders(uint256) each returned only this Safe. At block 94755196, Safe getThreshold() returned 3 and getOwners() returned seven addresses, including new owner 0x3b0dfce5306c98789533e22e61f8102ab00985cb. No enabled modules were returned; guard storage was zero; fallback-handler storage was 0xf48f2b2d2a534e402487b3ee7c18c33aec0fe5e4. VERSION() remained 1.3.0. The previous 3-of-6 and zero-fallback descriptions are stale.

controls.label: Polymarket PermissionedRamp (witness-gated wrapper)
controls.capDescription: Requires a valid EIP-712 witness signature and transfers the same amount of supported USDC or USDC.e from the caller into the token before wrapping.
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 94755001, PUSD rolesOf(PermissionedRamp) returned 2, owner() returned the Timelock, and correct EIP-1967 implementation/admin slots were zero. Verified PermissionedRamp source gates wrap/unwrap on per-asset pause state and an EIP-712 witness signature, then transfers collateral before wrapping. The witness-role census remains unverified; the signature gate is not represented as an independent protective multisig.

review.evidence: Pinned Polygon block 94755001 confirms changed token and module implementations, unchanged Timelock ownership, four previously authored wrapper holders plus PermissionedRamp with wrapper role 2, and three market modules with minter role 1. Each Timelock role returns the same Safe and minDelay() remains 43200. Polygon block 94755196 shows the Safe is now 3-of-7 with a nonzero fallback handler. Current verified source retains collateral-backed wrapping and position-claim settlement, but this session did not establish a complete token role history, PermissionedRamp witness census, or module bridge-role conservation boundary; no exhaustive authority claim is inferred.
